methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-fetched via WebFetch (mindmeister.com/en/pricing, xmind.com/pricing, coggle.it, mindomo.com/pricing, ayoa.com/pricing, mindmanager.com/en/pricing, mindmup.com/pricing, whimsical.com/pricing) on 2026-06-18. Where the official page rendered prices in a non-extractable form (MindManager shows '/year (incl. VAT)' with no figure; Ayoa loads prices via JS) or in EUR only (MindMeister, Mindomo), USD figures were NOT asserted from guesses — monthlyUsd was set to null and the EUR/GBP figure noted instead. Per 'a null beats a guess', no USD price is invented. MindManager annual figures ($99/$179) are third-party corroborated (ecommerceparadise.com, ITQlick, G2) and explicitly flagged as not confirmed on the official page. annualDiscountPct reflects each vendor's stated savings percentage. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: MindMeister
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched at mindmeister.com/en/pricing 2026-06-18; prices displayed in EUR only (€0 / €6.50 / €10.50 / €15.50 per user/month); no USD pricing published on official page, so monthlyUsd left null for paid tiers. Integration list from mindmeister.com/pages/integrations.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free; up to 3 mind maps, unlimited collaborators, templates, mobile apps, AI map creation (Beta), MeisterTask integration. Price shown as €0 on official page.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: €6.50/user/month (EUR only; USD not published on official page). Unlimited maps, 2 attachments per map, 7-day version history, private maps, file exports, Microsoft Teams integration. Annual billing saves up to 22%.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: €10.50/user/month (EUR only; USD not published on official page). Unlimited attachments, unlimited version history, multiple admins, Google Workspace integration, custom branding. Annual billing saves up to 22%.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: €15.50/user/month (EUR only; USD not published on official page). Group sharing, compliance exports/backups, SAML SSO (via sales), automated access approval, dedicated Customer Success Manager, personalized onboarding. Annual billing saves up to 22%.

enrichment.provenance: Pricing and feature data from official MindMeister pricing and integrations pages fetched 2026-06-18; prices EUR-only.

vendors.name: XMind
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched at xmind.com/pricing 2026-06-18. USD prices confirmed from the page (annual billing with monthly-equivalent shown).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free; up to 10 maps, basic themes and stickers, 3-day version history, publish with links, up to 5 Pitch slides, 10 AI credits.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $4.92/month per user billed annually (up to 50% off vs monthly). Up to 50 maps with basic collaboration, custom themes, export without watermark (PNG/SVG/PDF/Markdown/Office), unlimited Pitch slides, 10 AI credits. Covers up to 5 Mac/PCs and 5 mobile devices.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $8.25/month per user billed annually (up to 50% off vs monthly). Most popular. Unlimited collaborative maps, real-time collaboration, 30-day version history, unlimited sheets, Gantt charts, task management with assignees, 500 AI credits/month, text-to-map AI. Covers up to 5 Mac/PCs and 5 mobile devices.

enrichment.provenance: All data from official xmind.com/pricing page fetched 2026-06-18.

plans.name: Free

vendors.name: Mindomo
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched at mindomo.com/pricing 2026-06-18. Page renders prices in EUR (Free €0; Premium ~€6-€7/mo; Professional ~€13.50-€15/mo). USD figures vary across third-party sources ($5.50/$13.50 vs $7/$16) and are NOT published on the official page, so monthlyUsd left null for paid tiers (null beats a guess). Annual discount up to 20%; 14-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free; up to 3 diagrams, unlimited collaborators, sharing and publishing, free templates, iOS and Android apps, 1 trial AI credit. Shown as €0 on official page.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: ~€6-€7/user/month on official page (EUR; USD not published and third-party USD figures conflict, so null). Unlimited diagrams, 10 export formats, file/multimedia attachments, printing, Microsoft Teams integration, API access, 50 AI credits/month. Annual saves up to 20%.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: ~€13.50-€15/month on official page for 1 user + 5 guests (EUR; USD not published, draft's $16 contradicted the €15 figure, so null). All Premium features plus Gantt Charts, 20 export formats, business templates, guest editing, premium sharing, 60 AI credits/month. Annual saves up to 20%.

enrichment.provenance: All pricing from official mindomo.com/pricing page fetched 2026-06-18; EUR-rendered, 14-day money-back guarantee noted. No standalone free trial (Free plan is forever-free), so freeTrialDays null.

vendors.name: Ayoa
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page fetched at ayoa.com/pricing 2026-06-18; numeric prices are JS-loaded and did NOT render. USD monthly price could not be confirmed and third-party sources conflict ($13 annual-equivalent vs $17 monthly billing), so monthlyUsd set null (null beats a guess). GBP rates corroborated: £13/month, £10/month annual, £7/month 2-year.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free for personal use (not commercial). Up to 10 mind maps; whiteboards and task boards become view-only after the 7-day trial. No AI functionality.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: USD monthly price not published on official page (JS-loaded) and sources conflict: ~$13/mo is the discounted ANNUAL-equivalent while monthly-billing USD is reported at ~$17 — so monthlyUsd set null rather than guess. GBP corroborated at £13/month, £10/month annual, £7/month 2-year (annual saves up to 20%; 2-year ~33% saving). Unlimited mind maps, whiteboards, task boards; AI-powered mind mapping; organic mind map mode; Gantt view; presentation mode; dyslexia/ADHD/autism accessibility features; Google and Microsoft integrations.

keyFeatures: Built-in task boards and Gantt view
enrichment.provenance: Official page fetched 2026-06-18 but prices did not render (JS); USD monthly price unconfirmed and conflicting across sources, so null. GBP figures corroborated.

vendors.name: MindManager

plans.name: Organization

vendors.name: Whimsical
